en: Psalms 78

p.src: A contemplation by Asaph.

en: A contemplation by Asaph.
u.src: A contemplation by Asaph.

p.src: 1  Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.

en: Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.
u.src: 1  Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.

p.src: 2  I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,

en: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,
u.src: 2  I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,

p.src: 3  which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

en: which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
u.src: 3  which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

p.src: 4  We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.

en: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.
u.src: 4  We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.

p.src: 5  For he established a covenant in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;

en: For he established a covenant in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;
u.src: 5  For he established a covenant in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;

p.src: 6  that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,

en: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,
u.src: 6  that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,

p.src: 7  that they might set their hope in God, and not forget God’s deeds, but keep his commandments,

en: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget God’s deeds, but keep his commandments,
u.src: 7  that they might set their hope in God, and not forget God’s deeds, but keep his commandments,

p.src: 8  and might not be as their fathers— a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.

en: and might not be as their fathers— a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.
u.src: 8  and might not be as their fathers— a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.

p.src: 9  The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

en: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
u.src: 9  The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

p.src: 10  They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.

en: They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.
u.src: 10  They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.

p.src: 11  They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.

en: They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.
u.src: 11  They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.

p.src: 12  He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

en: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
u.src: 12  He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

p.src: 13  He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.

en: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.
u.src: 13  He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.

p.src: 14  In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.

en: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.
u.src: 14  In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.

p.src: 15  He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.

en: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.
u.src: 15  He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.

p.src: 16  He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

en: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
u.src: 16  He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

p.src: 17  Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.

en: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.
u.src: 17  Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.

p.src: 18  They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.

en: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.
u.src: 18  They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.

p.src: 19  Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

en: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?
u.src: 19  Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

p.src: 20  Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide meat for his people?”

en: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide meat for his people?”
u.src: 20  Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide meat for his people?”

p.src: 21  Therefore the LORD heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,

en: Therefore the LORD heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,
u.src: 21  Therefore the LORD heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,

p.src: 22  because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.

en: because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.
u.src: 22  because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.

p.src: 23  Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.

en: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.
u.src: 23  Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.

p.src: 24  He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.

en: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.
u.src: 24  He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.

p.src: 25  Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.

en: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.
u.src: 25  Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.

p.src: 26  He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.

en: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.
u.src: 26  He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.

p.src: 27  He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.

en: He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.
u.src: 27  He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.

p.src: 28  He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.

en: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.
u.src: 28  He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.

p.src: 29  So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.

en: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.
u.src: 29  So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.

p.src: 30  They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,

en: They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,
u.src: 30  They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,

p.src: 31  when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their strongest, and struck down the young men of Israel.

en: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their strongest, and struck down the young men of Israel.
u.src: 31  when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their strongest, and struck down the young men of Israel.

p.src: 32  For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.

en: For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.
u.src: 32  For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.

p.src: 33  Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.

en: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.
u.src: 33  Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.

p.src: 34  When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.

en: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.
u.src: 34  When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.

p.src: 35  They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.

en: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.
u.src: 35  They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.

p.src: 36  But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.

en: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.
u.src: 36  But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.

p.src: 37  For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.

en: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.
u.src: 37  For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.

p.src: 38  But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.

en: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.
u.src: 38  But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.

p.src: 39  He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.

en: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.
u.src: 39  He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.

p.src: 40  How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!

en: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!
u.src: 40  How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!

p.src: 41  They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

en: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
u.src: 41  They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

p.src: 42  They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;

en: They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;
u.src: 42  They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;

p.src: 43  how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,

en: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,
u.src: 43  how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,

p.src: 44  he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.

en: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.
u.src: 44  he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.

p.src: 45  He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

en: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
u.src: 45  He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

p.src: 46  He also gave their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.

en: He also gave their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.
u.src: 46  He also gave their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.

p.src: 47  He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.

en: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.
u.src: 47  He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.

p.src: 48  He also gave over their livestock to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

en: He also gave over their livestock to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
u.src: 48  He also gave over their livestock to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

p.src: 49  He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.

en: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.
u.src: 49  He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.

p.src: 50  He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,

en: He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,
u.src: 50  He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,

p.src: 51  and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.

en: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.
u.src: 51  and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.

p.src: 52  But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

en: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
u.src: 52  But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

p.src: 53  He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

en: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
u.src: 53  He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

p.src: 54  He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.

en: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.
u.src: 54  He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.

p.src: 55  He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

en: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
u.src: 55  He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

p.src: 56  Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies,

en: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies,
u.src: 56  Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies,

p.src: 57  but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.

en: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.
u.src: 57  but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.

p.src: 58  For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.

en: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.
u.src: 58  For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.

p.src: 59  When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,

en: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,
u.src: 59  When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,

p.src: 60  so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men,

en: so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men,
u.src: 60  so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men,

p.src: 61  and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.

en: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.
u.src: 61  and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.

p.src: 62  He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.

en: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.
u.src: 62  He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.

p.src: 63  Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.

en: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.
u.src: 63  Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.

p.src: 64  Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.

en: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.
u.src: 64  Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.

p.src: 65  Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.

en: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.
u.src: 65  Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.

p.src: 66  He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.

en: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.
u.src: 66  He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.

p.src: 67  Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,

en: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,
u.src: 67  Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,

p.src: 68  But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.

en: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.
u.src: 68  But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.

p.src: 69  He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.

en: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.
u.src: 69  He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.

p.src: 70  He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;

en: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;
u.src: 70  He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;

p.src: 71  from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.

en: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.
u.src: 71  from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.

p.src: 72  So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.

en: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.
u.src: 72  So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.
